conventions: Every new TypeScript/TSX source file must start with the standard Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026; existing modified files must keep their original copyright year.

Use Prettier formatting (@backstage/cli/config/prettier: single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indentation) and pass ESLint (@backstage/eslint-plugin rules including @backstage/no-undeclared-imports and react-hooks/rules-of-hooks).

All user-facing strings in @backstage/plugin-notifications must be defined in notificationsTranslationRef (plugins/notifications/src/translation.ts) and accessed via useTranslationRef from @backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha.

Unit tests run in Jest (jsdom) via backstage-cli package test; in plugins/notifications use @testing-library/react screen/findBy* queries and renderInTestApp/TestApiProvider from @backstage/test-utils without data-testid attributes or real network calls; in plugins/home-react only import packages declared in plugins/home-react/package.json (such as react and react-dom/client).

decisions.choice: In plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx, import Progress as DefaultProgress from @backstage/core-components and translationApiRef/useApiHolder from @backstage/frontend-plugin-api, falling back to DefaultProgress when useApp() throws and to default 'Settings' text when translationApiRef is absent from ApiHolder.
rejected: Requiring legacy AppContext via unconditional useApp() call
Adding @backstage/test-utils to plugins/home-react/package.json (out of allowlist scope)
decisions.reason: Allows CardExtension and HomePageWidgetBlueprint widgets to render in environments and tests without legacy AppContext or full ApiProvider while preserving custom Progress override when AppContext is present.

decisions.topic: Unread notifications card component structure and exports
decisions.choice: Create plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.tsx exporting Content and HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps, re-exported via HomePageUnreadNotifications/index.ts, wired as HomePageUnreadNotifications via createCardExtension in src/plugin.ts (and src/index.ts) and as homePageUnreadNotificationsWidget via HomePageWidgetBlueprint.make({ name: 'unread-notifications', ... }) in src/alpha.tsx.
rejected: Exporting only a raw InfoCard component without createCardExtension or HomePageWidgetBlueprint
Creating a separate hook file for signal/polling refresh only used by one component
decisions.reason: Follows the exact @backstage/plugin-home-react card extension and alpha widget blueprint conventions used in @backstage/plugin-home while keeping the file set minimal.

decisions.topic: Live refresh via signals with polling fallback and cleanup
decisions.choice: Inside HomePageUnreadNotifications Content, subscribe with useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications'); when isSignalsAvailable is true and lastSignal updates, invoke retryRef.current(); when isSignalsAvailable is false and pollingIntervalMs > 0 (default 10000), run setInterval calling retryRef.current() and clearInterval on unmount or dependency change.
rejected: Polling unconditionally even when signals are available
Putting retry directly in useEffect dependency arrays causing re-subscription loops
decisions.reason: Satisfies real-time signal refresh when signalApiRef is registered, degrades gracefully to timer polling when unavailable, and guarantees subscription and timer cleanup on unmount.

decisions.topic: Deep-link URL format and highlight handling on NotificationsPage and NotificationsTable
decisions.choice: Each card item links to `${notificationsRoute}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}`; NotificationsPage and NotificationsTable readsearchParams.get('id') via useSearchParams from react-router-dom (plus optional highlightedId prop on NotificationsTableProps) and highlight the matching row with styles.highlightedRow, aria-current='true', and Table rowStyle.
rejected: Using route path parameters (/notifications/:id) which would break existing rootRouteRef mounting
Highlighting only in NotificationsPage without support in NotificationsTable
decisions.reason: Preserves the existing /notifications route structure while enabling both NotificationsPage and standalone NotificationsTable renders to visually and semantically highlight the targeted notification.

decisions.topic: Translation keys for the unread notifications card
decisions.choice: Add homePageCard: { title: 'Unread notifications', emptyMessage: 'No unread notifications', markAsRead: 'Mark as read', errors: { markAsReadFailed: 'Failed to mark notification as read' } } to notificationsTranslationRef in plugins/notifications/src/translation.ts.
decisions.reason: Centralizes all card text, accessible button labels, and error toast messages in notificationsTranslationRef.
